name: serverUrl
label: Server URL
help: The address of the Data Center Expert server, for example `https://dce.example.com`. The `/isxg` REST API path is added automatically.

pattern.message: Enter a URL starting with https://

name: username
label: Username
help: A Data Center Expert user with access to the device groups to monitor.

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when the Data Center Expert server uses a self-signed certificate.

fields.name: clientId
fields.label: OAuth client ID
fields.help: Only needed if the Data Center Expert token endpoint rejects sign-in without a client. Leave blank by default.
